column1: # Dockerfile and Containerfile counters, for a rule with the prompt file-body-ops: one per line,
# label TAB pattern (Java regex). The [ignore] line blanks comment lines (a # at the start of a line,
# after blanks; a parser directive such as "# syntax=" is a comment too) and the lines a backslash at
# the end of a line continues, with the comment and empty lines among them, as Docker reads them. An
# instruction counts at the start of a line, in any case, so a word in a RUN command continued over
# lines does not, not even an env or a from that starts a continued line.
# "build stages" counts every FROM; "environment entries" an ENV or ARG instruction, not each name
# of one. OpsFactPatternsTest pins every case; ProfileFactPatternsLinearityTest measures that
